name: sf-org-deploy-wrapper
description: Deploy, retrieve and diff Salesforce metadata against any authenticated org from a convenient sidebar panel.

commands.title: SF Deploy: Deploy Manifest to Org
SF Deploy: Retrieve Manifest from Org

sfOrgDeployWrapper.commandTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for the `sf` CLI commands this extension runs on your behalf: deploys, validations, quick deploys, retrieves, diff queries (the Tooling API fast path and the retrieve-based fallback), Fetch Org metadata listings, and Open in Org — not just deploy/retrieve. VS Code doesn't enforce the `minimum` below at runtime, so the extension itself clamps whatever you set here to a 10-second floor; anything lower would time out every command before it could get off the ground.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.ignoreDeployConflicts.markdownDescription: Pass `--ignore-conflicts` to `sf project deploy start`. Off by default: the CLI will refuse to overwrite org changes that aren't in your local source. Machine-scoped so a committed `.vscode/settings.json` can't silently disable conflict protection for everyone who clones the repo.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.fetchIncludeManaged.markdownDescription: When fetching org metadata, include components from installed managed packages. Off by default: managed-package components are read-only and add thousands of non-editable entries to the browse tree.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.fetchOrgOnOpen.markdownDescription: Run Fetch Org automatically once per session when the panel first opens, so local/org badges and org-only components appear without a manual click. Later refreshes — including after switching orgs — stay manual via the Fetch Org button. Turn off to avoid the org API calls on panel open.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.fetchConcurrency.markdownDescription: How many metadata types to fetch in parallel when browsing org metadata. Lower this if Fetch Org strains your machine; raise it for faster fetches on a capable machine. Machine-scoped — it's a machine-capability knob, so syncing one value across a desktop and a weak laptop would be wrong.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.typeCacheDays.markdownDescription: How many days to cache metadata-type rules learned from the `sf` CLI registry (types this extension doesn't know built in are resolved via `sf project generate manifest`, run offline — no org call). The SAME cache/TTL also backs the negative side: folders where that resolution FAILED, so a lost cause isn't retried on every scan. Set to 0 to disable both — every type is re-resolved from scratch each scan, and every previously-failed folder is re-probed (up to 30 seconds each) on every session start and every refresh, instead of being remembered as a lost cause.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.changedBaseRef.markdownDescription: When set — e.g. `main` or `origin/main` — the **Changed** view shows components whose files differ from that git ref (committed changes included: the release-promotion question — "what will this branch deploy?"), instead of only uncommitted changes. Uncommitted edits are always included on top. Empty (the default) = uncommitted changes only.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.openDiffInFloatingWin.markdownDescription: Pop org-comparison diffs into their own OS window (auxiliary window). Turn off to keep them as diff tabs in the main window.

enumDescriptions: Smart default — RunLocalTests against a production org, NoTestRun against a sandbox or scratch org.
Run no Apex tests. Salesforce rejects this test level for a production deploy.
Run all Apex tests in this org's own namespace (excludes installed managed packages).
Run every Apex test in the org, including tests belonging to installed managed packages.
sfOrgDeployWrapper.defaultTestLevel.markdownDescription: The Apex test level preselected in the panel's picker, and used by context-menu / editor right-click deploys when the picker hasn't been touched yet this session. Empty (the default) means a smart default: `RunLocalTests` against a production org, `NoTestRun` against a sandbox. `RunSpecifiedTests` is deliberately not offered here — it needs a per-deploy list of test classes, which one global setting has no way to carry.

sfOrgDeployWrapper.backupBeforeRetrieve.markdownDescription: Before a retrieve overwrites your local files, save the current copies first so the overwrite is undoable via **SF Deploy: Restore Retrieve Backup**. Backups are kept for the last 5 retrieves per workspace (older ones are pruned). A retrieve is aborted if its backup can't be written — the safety net is the whole point, so proceeding without it silently would be worse.

skrety.salesforce.targetOrg.markdownDescription: Shared target Salesforce org (username or alias) for the Skrety SF plugin family. Set from the org picker in any of the plugins; machine-scoped so it isn't synced to other machines. Leave empty to fall back to the CLI default org.
